objective: Implement deterministic risk-based position sizing that consumes a P15-A policy-capacity decision and explicit governed numeric inputs without authorizing leverage, portfolio limits, execution or broker orders.
scope: Consume only POLICY_CAPACITY_ELIGIBLE upstream risk-policy decisions
Support LONG and SHORT linear price-loss geometry
Calculate explicit risk amount from account equity and governed risk-budget basis points
Calculate per-unit stop loss from entry, stop and contract multiplier
Floor candidate quantity to an explicit quantity step
Guarantee planned stop loss does not exceed the requested risk amount
Fail closed for invalid geometry, non-positive values, zero-sized output or upstream veto
Provide deterministic candidate and decision identities
dependencies: Owner P15 phase authorization already granted
tests: LONG stop must be below entry
SHORT stop must be above entry
All monetary/price/multiplier/step values must be positive
Risk budget must be within [1,10000] bps
Quantity floors deterministically to explicit step
Planned stop loss never exceeds risk amount
Zero quantity after flooring is vetoed
No leverage or execution authority is emitted
P15-B evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P15-B module/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P15-A remains canonical complete and P15-C remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
